items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I remember when he'd taken that note from Lawrence.

ctx.x: Well, it's something, yeah. It's something Plyde wrote up, the trumpet play, Plyde Wilson.
I remember when he'd taken that note from Lawrence.
So now that you got famous, someday people come and listen to this, you know. Oh! I know.
